create.name: Solala Towler
create.bio:
Solala Towler teaches Daoist practice from Eugene, Oregon, where he runs the Abode of the Eternal Tao. He has studied the Daoist arts for more than three decades, learning qigong forms such as Wuji Gong and Chinese Essence Qigong from Chinese teachers including Chen Fu Yin. For a quarter of a century he edited and published The Empty Vessel, a journal of Daoist thought and practice, and he once served as president of the National Qigong Association.

His teaching brings together sitting, standing and moving meditation, qigong, the classic Daoist stories, the I Ching and the Way of Tea, which he shares through the gongfu tea ceremony. Students can work with him one to one, in person in Eugene or over video calls, invite him to lead a weekend qigong seminar in their own area, or study at home with his recorded course on Daoism. He has also taken small groups to China and Taiwan to visit temples, teahouses and Daoist teachers. His books include Practicing the Tao Te Ching, Returning to the Source, Cha Dao, Tea Mind Tea Heart and Tales from the Tao, and he records guided meditations, qigong lessons and short courses for Insight Timer.

videos.title: A One-hour session on The Mystical Dao De Jing

books.title: Practicing the Tao Te Ching: 81 Steps on the Way
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: Takes each of the 81 verses of Lao Tzu's classic in turn and pairs it with a practical step, so the text becomes a guide to daily spiritual practice rather than only philosophy. Published by Sounds True.

books.title: Returning to the Source: Daoist Meditations for Rediscovering the Sacred in Everyday Life
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: A practice book of more than thirty meditations from the Daoist tradition, mixing stillness and gentle movement with breathing, visualisation and qigong. Each practice is short enough to fit into an ordinary day.

books.title: Cha Dao: The Way of Tea, Tea as a Way of Life
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: Follows Chinese tea culture from mountain temples to the modern cup and links it to Daoist ideas such as non-striving. Quotes from old tea masters and poets run through the book.

books.title: Tea Mind Tea Heart: A Journey Through the Dao of Tea
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: Stories, poems and short essays on drinking Chinese tea as a meditation and a way of slowing down, illustrated with colour photographs. A companion to his tea teaching.

books.title: Tales from the Tao: The Wisdom of the Taoist Masters
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: Thirty-one teaching stories from Chuang Tzu, Lao Tzu and other Daoist sources, retold with commentary and set beside photographs by John Cleare. Some are puzzles to sit with, others are simply funny.

books.title: The Tao of Intimacy and Ecstasy: Realizing the Promise of Spiritual Union
books.author: Solala Towler
books.description: Applies Daoist ideas of yin and yang and natural harmony to love and partnership, with practices for individuals and couples on communication, closeness and shared energy.

courses.title: Embarking Upon the Way: A Course in Taoism
courses.description: A home-study course on the main principles of Daoism with several hours of audio teaching, video, seven guided meditations and an accompanying book as a PDF. It also touches on tea, Chinese medicine theory and the Great Mother. Also sold on a flash drive for $69 USD.

courses.title: Qigong Training with Solala Towler
courses.description: Weekend seminars in two Daoist qigong forms, Wuji Gong and Chinese Essence Qigong, open to newcomers and experienced students. Groups can host a seminar in their own area.

courses.title: Personal Cultivation Classes with Solala
courses.description: One-to-one lessons in qigong, Daoist meditation and the I Ching, and private gongfu tea ceremonies, in person in Eugene or online. Arranged through his contact page or by phone.

courses.title: Returning To The Source: Taoist Energy Meditation
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions covering seated, standing and moving Daoist meditation, a golden light visualisation, a water practice and a closing meditation on the Great Mother.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Tea Mind Tea Heart
courses.description: An eight-day Insight Timer course on tea as a contemplative practice, covering the principles of Cha Dao and gongfu preparation and ending with a guided tea meditation to do alone or with friends.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Solala Towler on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Dozens of his guided Daoist meditations, qigong sessions, chants and relaxation practices, free to play in the app or on the web, plus several longer courses.

free_resources.title: Organ Balancing Meditation
free_resources.description: Written instructions for a seated Daoist practice that moves coloured light through the five main organs in turn, each linked to a quality to cultivate. Free to read on his site.

Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch.
Email solala@abodetao.com appears on the (expired, 2024) Taiwan tour page; the qigong training page shows it truncated as 'solala@abodetao'. Contact page has a form only.
Facebook link is the Abode of the Eternal Dao page (his organisation), not a personal profile.
YouTube titles are as uploaded (several in capitals, e.g. 'CHUANG TZU 10:30:24'); view counts are low (hundreds to a few thousand).
Insight Timer course 'Organ Balancing And Healing Sounds Qigong' and the 'Introduction To Qigong' description use healing language; not used.
